card.name: Last piece of a drug name before overdose
card.fires_on: The final piece of a drug name that is split into several parts, when the next word is likely a noun such as overdose, poisoning or errors. It is strongest in overdose and poisoning sections.

modes.label: Drug name ending before overdose
modes.description: The closing piece of a multi-part generic or brand drug name, followed by overdose or poisoning.
modes.example: Ipecac syrup should be avoided in theophyll<<ine>> overdoses.

modes.label: Other name endings
modes.description: The end of a virus, product or isotope name, or a word just before a noun like infection or imaging.

card.writes: It seems to suppress disease and disorder words and promote biological terms like DNA and metabolism, so the next word is steered away from a condition name.
card.plain: It marks the end of a drug name that is about to be followed by words like overdose or poisoning.
